title: Design System: Old MacDonald Had a School

body.purpose: Readable paragraphs, instructions, labels, and controls.

hand.purpose: Short teacher cue, quote, or reminder.

shadows.name: working-wall-support
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 .35rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-paper) 72%, transparent), 0 .65rem 1.25rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 18%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Separates an installed working-wall support from its environment.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.value: 0 .3rem 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-wood) 32%, transparent), 0 .65rem 1rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 13%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Lifts readable paper one plane above its support.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keeps keyboard focus visible above decorative layers.

shadows.name: grade-tab-hover
shadows.purpose: Signals hover on a grade-owned surface.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Controls transform, shadow, and background feedback on interactive surfaces.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Removes nonessential animation when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Shared default action with a readable 44 px touch height and semantic focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: .14rem solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 800 1rem/1.7 var(--font-farm-body, Nunito, sans-serif); transition: transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 .35rem .55rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 20%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: Readable live content lifted one plane above its supporting surface.
components.html:
Learning purpose

Notice, test, make, explain, and share.
components.css: .ds-paper-card { padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background-color: var(--brand-paper, var(--card)); color: var(--brand-paper-foreground, var(--card-foreground)); background-image: var(--asset-cardboard-ivory); background-repeat: repeat; background-size: 320px; box-shadow: 0 .3rem 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-wood) 32%, transparent), 0 .65rem 1rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 13%, transparent); transition: transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-paper-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-paper-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Five Grade Surface Chips
components.description: All five grade-owned routing surfaces shown together with canonical signal art.
components.css: .ds-grade-rail { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.65rem; padding:1rem; background:#1E2A38; border-radius:1rem; } .ds-grade-rail button { --g:#F6AF32; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.45rem; min-height:44px; padding:.45rem .8rem; border:2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--g) 70%, #1E2A38); border-radius:.8rem; background:var(--g); color:#1E2A38; font:800 .9rem/1.2 Nunito,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 .22rem 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--g) 65%,black); } .ds-grade-rail button[data-grade="pre-school"] { --g:#5D8164; color:#FEFCE8; } .ds-grade-rail button[data-grade="kindergarten"] { --g:#267CBA; color:#FEFCE8; } .ds-grade-rail button[data-grade="grade-one"] { --g:#D95C86; } .ds-grade-rail button[data-grade="grade-two"] { --g:#D81D24; color:#FEFCE8; } .ds-grade-rail img { width:2rem; height:2rem; object-fit:contain; } .ds-grade-rail button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #D4A82A; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Shared readable paper field for teacher-facing search.
components.css: .ds-search-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: .14rem solid #C4A07A; border-radius: .375rem; background-color: #FDF8E3; background-image: url('/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/cardboard/cardboard-ivory-tile.webp'); background-repeat: repeat; background-size: 320px; color: #1A2A2E; font: 400 1rem/1.7 Nunito, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #5C635F; opacity: 1; } .ds-search-input:hover { border-color: #A66A32; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #D4A82A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Character Artwork Roles
components.description: Old MacDonald shown as full-body portrait, transparent face patch, and embroidered badge.
components.css: .ds-character-roles { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:1rem; margin:0; padding:1rem; border-radius:1rem; background:#FDF8E3; color:#1A2A2E; } .ds-character-roles div { display:grid; place-items:center; gap:.4rem; min-height:10rem; padding:.65rem; border:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,#A66A32 45%,transparent); border-radius:.85rem; background:#FEFCE8; font:800 .8rem/1.2 Nunito,sans-serif; } .ds-character-roles .ds-owned { background-color:#A66A32; background-image:linear-gradient(#A66A32,#A66A32),url("/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/felt/felt-01-old-macdonald-tile.webp"); background-blend-mode:color,normal; color:#FEFCE8; } .ds-character-roles img { display:block; max-width:100%; width:7rem; height:8rem; object-fit:contain; }

components.name: Subject Signal Tray
components.description: Production subject art remains semantic: music, mathematics, visual arts, and physical education.
components.css: .ds-subject-tray { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:.75rem; padding:1rem; border:3px solid #C4A07A; border-radius:1rem; background:#FDF8E3; } .ds-subject-tray figure { display:grid; place-items:center; gap:.35rem; margin:0; min-height:7rem; padding:.6rem; border-radius:.75rem; background:#FEFCE8; color:#1A2A2E; font:800 .75rem/1.2 Nunito,sans-serif; text-align:center; } .ds-subject-tray img { width:4rem; height:4rem; object-fit:contain; }

components.name: Material Library
components.description: Real construction paper, felt, cardboard, denim, woven fabric, and leather—not flat color chips.
components.html: Construction paperFeltCardboardDenimWovenLeather
components.css: .ds-materials { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:.75rem; padding:1rem; background:#FDF8E3; border-radius:1rem; } .ds-materials span { display:grid; place-items:end start; min-height:6rem; padding:.6rem; border:2px solid rgba(30,42,56,.22); border-radius:.75rem; background-size:190px; color:#1E2A38; font:900 .78rem/1.2 Nunito,sans-serif; text-shadow:0 1px #FEFCE8; } .ds-materials .construction { background-image:url("/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/construction-paper/construction-paper-05-mr-sam-tile.webp"); } .ds-materials .felt { background-image:url("/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/felt/felt-03-mr-rusty-tile.webp"); color:#FEFCE8; text-shadow:0 1px #1E2A38; } .ds-materials .cardboard { background-image:url("/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/cardboard/cardboard-ivory-tile.webp"); } .ds-materials .denim { background-image:url("/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/denim/denim-dark-indigo-tile-v01.webp"); color:#FEFCE8; text-shadow:0 1px #1E2A38; } .ds-materials .woven { background-image:url("/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/woven-fabric/woven-fabric-01-old-macdonald-tile.webp"); color:#FEFCE8; text-shadow:0 1px #1E2A38; } .ds-materials .leather { background-image:url("/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/leather/individual-tiles/03-mr-rusty-leather-tile-v01.webp"); color:#FEFCE8; text-shadow:0 1px #1E2A38; }

components.name: Credibly Attached Note
components.description: Pins and tape are the working wall signature; each fastener crosses the paper and its support.
components.html:
Teacher note

Sing it twice, then invite the children to lead.
components.css: .ds-board { padding:2rem; border:4px solid #C4A07A; border-radius:1rem; background-color:#1E2A38; background-image:url("/design-assets/web-material-library-v1/denim/denim-dark-indigo-tile-v01.webp"); } .ds-note { position:relative; padding:1.5rem 1.25rem; border-radius:.35rem; background:#FDF8E3; color:#1A2A2E; box-shadow:0 .5rem 1rem rgba(0,0,0,.24); font:400 1rem/1.6 Nunito,sans-serif; } .ds-note strong { font-family:Boogaloo,sans-serif; font-size:1.35rem; } .ds-pin { position:absolute; width:2.1rem; height:2.1rem; object-fit:contain; top:-1.05rem; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); } .ds-tape { position:absolute; width:4.5rem; height:2.2rem; object-fit:contain; right:-1rem; bottom:-.8rem; transform:rotate(-7deg); }

components.name: Brand and Classroom Scene
components.description: The compact emblem and real classroom hero establish Old MacDonald before prose.
components.css: .ds-brand-scene { position:relative; margin:0; overflow:hidden; min-height:14rem; border:4px solid #C4A07A; border-radius:1rem; background:#1E2A38; } .ds-brand-scene .ds-scene { display:block; width:100%; height:18rem; object-fit:cover; } .ds-brand-scene .ds-emblem { position:absolute; z-index:1; width:5rem; height:5rem; object-fit:contain; top:.8rem; left:.8rem; padding:.4rem; border-radius:50%; background:#FDF8E3; box-shadow:0 .4rem .8rem rgba(0,0,0,.28); }

narrative.overview:
This system translates the official character record into a framework-neutral contract for websites, presentations, printable resources, editorial pages, and other generated artifacts.

It serves an educator-facing curriculum product. Its job is to make a specific learning purpose and the practical material needed to lead it easy to understand at a glance. The visual world is not children’s entertainment and not a generic dashboard: it is a welcoming, capable working environment for planning and leading real learning experiences.

rules.name: The One Semantic Owner Rule
rules.body: Character color and felt belong only to that character. Grade color belongs to that grade. Subject color and icon belong to curriculum meaning. Generic navigation and controls use shared semantic UI roles, never character texture.

rules.name: The Credible Attachment Rule
rules.body: A fastener must cross artifact and support.

dos: Do use exact approved identity colors and canonical art from this file.
Do put readable information on paper.
Do treat pins, tape, clips, and fasteners as the signature attachment language of the working wall; every pinned artifact visibly crosses artifact and support.
Do keep content live across media.
Do preserve all assets pending explicit classification.
Do keep the complete character record in this file only; pages render it, they do not redefine it.
donts: Don't treat cork as the whole design concept.
Don't use a floating decorative fastener.
Don't put paragraphs or controls on fabric.
Don't assign character felt to generic navigation or subjects.
Don't shrink dimensional art into compact UI.
Don't bake responsive text into images.
Don't infer authority from other Markdown files or file availability.
Don't exclude or substitute an image without approval.
Don't maintain character, grade, or subject color data in any file other than this one and its two CSS bindings.
